title: Floral Jhumka
description: Add a touch of elegance to your look with these beautifully handcrafted resin jhumkas. Made with love and attention to detail, each pair is lightweight, unique, and perfect for both everyday wear and special occasions. The delicate floral design and vibrant colors make them a charming accessory that complements ethnic as well as fusion outfits.

title: Daisy in the Dark
description: Delicate white daisies blooming against a sleek black backdrop — these handcrafted resin jhumkas are the perfect blend of elegance and charm. Lightweight, unique, and lovingly handmade, they're designed to add a touch of floral magic to every outfit. Whether you're dressing up for a festive occasion or adding a statement piece to your everyday look, these jhumkas are sure to turn heads.

title: Monstera Petal
description: Elevate your collection with these exquisitely handcrafted monstera-leaf earrings, where organic beauty meets refined artistry. Each piece is a miniature wearable canvas, meticulously cast to capture the iconic, sprawling silhouette of the tropical monstera plant.

title: Enchanted Garden
description:
A beautifully handcrafted rakhi featuring elegant green floral accents, shimmering stones, and pearl embellishments. Designed to symbolize love, prosperity, and cherished sibling bonds, this rakhi adds a touch of sophistication to your Raksha Bandhan celebrations.
Customization Available: Personalize it with a name, initials, photo, or special charm to make it truly one-of-a-kind.

title: Scarlet Blossom
description:
stunning handmade rakhi featuring rich ruby-red resin artistry, pearl accents, and intricate floral detailing. This luxurious design is crafted to create a lasting memory for your loved one.
Customization Available: Name, initials, photo, or personalized charm.

title: Golden Bloom
description:
Inspired by royal floral motifs, this rakhi features intricate stone work, elegant pearl tassels, and a timeless design. A perfect choice for those looking for a premium festive gift.
Customization Available: Initials, or preferred color theme

title: Threads of Nostalgia
description: A gentle tribute to the lifelong bond of love, protection, and shared childhoods. Threads of Nostalgia weaves together the sacred tradition of Rakhi with the delicate beauty of handmade artistry, capturing the quiet warmth of memories that tie siblings together forever.

title: Aurelia Rose Wall Clock
description: Elevate your space with a timeless masterpiece that bridges the gap between functional timepiece and luxury fine art.

details.artistNote: Hang the Aurelia Rose in an area with plenty of natural light or beneath a warm accent lamp. The metallic gold veining and raised numerals are designed to catch shifting light throughout the day, creating a dynamic visual experience. It acts as the perfect anchor piece for a living room gallery wall, a chic home office, or a luxury bedroom retreat.

title: Kesari Aura Resin Thali
description: A stunning 10 inch resin thali that combines traditional design with modern craftsmanship.

details.artistNote: The Kesari Aura Resin Thali is perfect for festive occasions and traditional ceremonies. Its vibrant colors and intricate design make it a centerpiece for any celebration.

title: Coastal Bloom Phone Cover
material: Resin, Real Flower, and Phone Cover
description: A beautiful phone cover that encapsulates the essence of coastal blooms in resin.

details.artistNote: The Coastal Bloom Phone Cover is a perfect blend of nature and craftsmanship, protecting your phone while showcasing delicate floral beauty.

title: Personalized Coin Platter
description: A personalized resin coin platter that combines elegance with functionality.

details.artistNote: The Personalized Resin Coin Platter is perfect for serving coins or small items with a touch of elegance. Its customizable design makes it a unique addition to any home.
